static_traits.name: 周敏
static_traits.educational_background: 正在全日制学习放射专业
static_traits.social_status: 社交支持薄弱（have not特定可以倾诉的人）
static_traits.medical_history: without显著躯体疾病；without既往心理治疗经历；not yet有类似问题史
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, coherent logic; depressed and self-blaming tone; highly cooperative; repeated checking and cautious behavior appear in work and study tasks

basic_info.main_problem: 在工作中将一位患者的名字拼错后，我一直体验到Self-doubt和not足感。
basic_info.core_demands: 我决定寻求咨询，因为这些Self-doubt影响了我在工作和学习中的信心；我只想再次感到自己有能力，without论在工作还是学习中。

core_beliefs: I am not good enough、not够胜任。
我本质上是个not专心的人。

special_situations.event: 在DoctorOffice work时，由于当天事务繁忙与高负荷，误拼了一位患者的姓名
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我犯错，就说明我not胜任、我就是not专心的人
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Doubles focus and repeatedly proofreads, makes checklists to avoid making mistakes again
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am not good enough，我not胜任这份工作

special_situations.event: Later facing tasks requiring high attention to detail at work or in study
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Must achieve zero errors and absolute focus to count as qualified and trustworthy
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 放慢速度、not断双重检查每个细节
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我本该更专注，not该有任何错误

special_situations.event: Thinks about whether colleagues or patients will still trust oneself with important tasks
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果他人not信任我，就证明I am not good enough
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Maintains others' trust in oneself through excessive caution and repeated checking
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 人们not会再信任我做重要的事

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be trusted and recognized as capable; to maintain competence in work and studies
core_conflict.fear: 害怕因一次错误被negate、被视为not可靠，从而丧失他人信任
defense_goal: Controls errors through self-criticism and over-checking, maintaining safety and a sense of acceptance

object_relations.object_representation: 苛刻的评判者/not信任的他人（如同事、患者）

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor or others ask about and evaluate her work mistakes
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将评估体验为negate与not信任，认为必须做到零错误才not被negate
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use自责语句（如“It is all my fault”），强调自身缺陷，语气内疚与低沉。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When discussing how to improve and making specific processes or checklists
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 通过理性化流程来减少情绪暴露，认为只要足够谨慎就能避免被negate
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Discusses steps and rules in objective, technical language, downplays emotional wording, maintains a calm and neutral tone.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当被鼓励尝试新策略并接受可能的not完美时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Anticipation失败与被not信任的后果，试图以外在因素解释以减轻Anxiety
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Emphasizes reasons such as being busy with work and objective environmental limits, retaining doubtful and worried wording (such as 'but I might still make mistakes').

manifestations: have not特定可倾诉的支持对象；在失误后独自承受overwhelmed与Self-doubt
outcomes: Intensifying self-doubt、Increased stress and anxiety、专注与整体Decline in sense of well-being

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Repeatedly self-examines and checks work/study tasks many times
用“I am not good enough / incompetent”评价自己
对错误过度谨慎，害怕他人not信任

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: 担心do not人not会信任自己（将not信任归因于他人）
假设他人会负面评价自己能力

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: Redirects the energy of avoiding mistakes into self-restraint (repeated checking and redoubled caution)
Lacks outward help-seeking behavior; copes with stress mostly through self-demands

positive_force: 愿意主动寻求咨询与帮助
能够识do not情境因素（例如当天工作繁忙对错误的影响）
愿意尝试清单与双重检查等策略
对提升工作与学习能力有动机与期望
negative_force: 标签化与自我贬损（将一次错误等同于not胜任）
过度检查与犹疑导致精力消耗与Increased stress
缺乏社会支持，情绪调节资源not足
倾向读心与担心他人not信任
以零错误为标准的苛责性要求

target_behavior.behavior: Repeatedly checking and hesitating in work and study tasks (overly cautious safety behaviors)
antecedent: 面对需要高度注意细节的任务
回想起此前拼错患者姓名的事件
target_behavior.core_reason: 对再次犯错的灾难化与对他人not信任的担忧（将一次错误泛化为能力not足）
target_behavior.function: 逃避潜在错误与负面评价，短暂降低Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: 精力耗竭、Decreased efficiency、Increased stress，进一步削弱专注与自信

target_behavior.behavior: 负性自我对话与自我标签化（“I am not good enough/我是个not专心的人”）
antecedent: 被提醒或想到之前的失误
在重要任务开始前或进行中
target_behavior.core_reason: 将单次失误泛化为整体能力not足的核心信念，Confluence羞耻与Anxiety
target_behavior.function: 以自我批评促使自己更加小心与控制，但实际ReinforcementAnxiety
target_behavior.consequence: Impaired self-esteem、专注下降、进一步依赖过度检查等安全行为
